title: Ackd for Agents — MCP server
excerpt: Connect your AI tools to your job search data via MCP.
content_html:
Your job search,
inside your AI tools.

One command connects Ackd to any MCP-compatible client. Your AI can read your applications, draft follow-ups, pick the right resume, and prep for interviews — all from your search data.

npx @ackd/install-mcp

After signing in, you'll see:

API Key ackd_live_••••••••••••••••

Config npx @ackd/install-mcp --key ackd_live_••••••••••••••••

Get your API key Try the Web App
